title: 热泉下的隐藏世界与会隐身的青蛙
pdf: https://michael-podcast-1513696684.cos.ap-chengdu.myqcloud.com/vol25/Vol25_晚读讲义_热泉下的隐藏世界与会隐身的青蛙_v2.pdf
pdfName: Vol25_晚读讲义_热泉下的隐藏世界与会隐身的青蛙_v2.pdf

blocks.en: Hello, young explorers, and welcome back to Michael's Morning Listening! Today we dive to the bottom of the sea, then visit a rainforest leaf. Our first hero lives beside hot water, two thousand five hundred metres under the sea. Our second hero is no bigger than your fingernail — but it knows a disappearing trick that surprises even scientists. Let's go!
blocks.title: 开场白
blocks.cn: 你好，小小探险家们，欢迎回到 Michael 的早听晚读！今天我们先潜入大海的最深处，再去一片雨林的叶子上做客。第一位主角住在热水边，在两千五百米深的海底；第二位主角只有你的指甲盖那么大，却会一门连科学家都惊讶的隐身术。出发吧！

blocks.en: Deep under the Pacific Ocean, where no sunlight comes, hot water erupts from cracks in the seafloor. These are hydrothermal vents — underwater hot springs, made where seawater meets hot rock below. Around the vents crowd giant tube worms and mussels, fed by tiny bacteria that live on the hot chemicals, not sunlight.
blocks.title: 热泉下的隐藏世界
blocks.cn: 在太平洋的深处，阳光照不到的地方，热水从海底的裂缝里喷涌而出。这就是深海热泉——海底的温泉，是海水在深处遇到滚烫的岩石形成的。热泉周围挤满了巨型管虫和贻贝，它们靠微小的细菌生活，这些细菌不靠阳光，靠热水里的化学物质活着。

blocks.en: It takes courage to explore a world no human can visit. Their ship waited far above, its engine humming, while their robot, SuBastian, did the diving. It sank two thousand five hundred metres to a volcano on the East Pacific Rise. It lifted heavy pieces of volcanic rock — and underneath, to the delight of the team, it found warm, hidden caves.
blocks.title: 热泉下的隐藏世界
blocks.cn: 探索一个人类无法亲身前往的世界，需要勇气。科考船在远远的上方等着，发动机轻轻轰鸣，深海机器人“苏巴斯蒂安”替他们潜了下去。它下潜到两千五百米深，来到东太平洋海隆上的一座火山。它搬开沉重的火山岩块——下面让全队欣喜的是，藏着温暖的、隐秘的洞穴。

blocks.en: Inside those caves, at twenty-five degrees, lived animals no one had expected: young tube worms and small snails, in the dark below the seafloor. The team also found a clue to an old mystery: baby tube worms are almost never seen above the vents. Now scientists think it is no coincidence — the babies travel under the seafloor, through warm water in the cracks, to start new homes.
blocks.title: 热泉下的隐藏世界
blocks.cn: 这些洞穴里水温二十五度，住着谁也没料到的动物：幼小的管虫和小蜗牛，都生活在海底之下的黑暗里。科考队还找到了一条解开老谜团的线索：人们几乎从没在热泉上方的海水里见过管虫宝宝。那么，新的热泉家园是怎么开始的呢？现在科学家认为，这不是巧合——管虫宝宝是穿过海底之下裂缝里的暖水，游去远方安新家的。

blocks.en: Now meet a frog that can almost disappear. The glassfrog lives in the rainforests of Central and South America. It is small and green, and its flesh is so clear you can see its heart and stomach right through it — like looking through glass. By day, it sleeps on the underside of a leaf, where hungry birds could easily spot it. So how does it stay safe?
blocks.title: 会隐身的青蛙
blocks.cn: 现在认识一只几乎会消失的青蛙。玻璃蛙生活在中美洲和南美洲的雨林里。它又小又绿，身体清透得能直接透过它看到心脏和胃——就像透过玻璃一样。白天，它睡在叶子的背面，饿鸟很容易就能发现它。那么，它是怎么保护自己的呢？

blocks.en: Scientists found the answer with a special camera that can see blood moving inside the body. When the glassfrog sleeps, it packs almost ninety percent of its red blood cells into its liver, hidden behind tiny mirror-like crystals. With the red cells out of the way, light passes through the frog's body, and it becomes two or three times more see-through — it simply fades into the leaf. Their primary job, carrying oxygen, can wait until the frog wakes up.
blocks.title: 会隐身的青蛙
blocks.cn: 科学家用一台能看到血液在体内流动的特殊相机找到了答案。玻璃蛙睡觉时，会把将近百分之九十的红细胞收进肝脏，藏在细小的镜面晶体后面。红细胞挪开后，光就能穿过蛙的身体，它变得两三倍更透明——简直就融进了叶子。红细胞的主要工作是运送氧气，这项工作可以等青蛙醒来再做。

blocks.en: When it wakes, the cells rush back into the blood in seconds, and it can jump away. Most animals could never do this safely — but the glassfrog does it every day, and its trick may teach doctors new ideas about blood.
blocks.title: 会隐身的青蛙
blocks.cn: 青蛙醒来时，红细胞几秒钟内就涌回血液，它马上就能跳走。大多数动物可不敢这样做——但玻璃蛙每天都这么做，它的本事说不定还能给医生们关于血液的新启发。

blocks.en: Here's today's idiom: "read between the lines." Words on a page say one thing — but the real message may hide between the lines. If you read between the lines, you notice clues and understand what is not said. The deep-sea scientists did just that: they read between the lines of the ocean's clues and found a hidden world. Here's an example: "When Mia said she was 'fine' with a tiny smile, I read between the lines — she was sad." What hidden messages have you found?
blocks.title: 今日俚语
blocks.cn: 今天的俚语是“read between the lines”（读字里行间）：纸上的字写着一层意思，可真正的意思也许就藏在字里行间。如果你 read between the lines，就是留意线索、读懂没有明说的意思。深海科学家正是这么做的：他们读懂了大海线索里的言外之意，找到了一个隐藏的世界。举个例子：米娅说自己“挺好的”，脸上却带着一丝勉强的微笑，我读出了言外之意——她其实很难过。你发现过哪些隐藏的信息呢？

blocks.en: Let's think about our stories. We found a hidden world under deep-sea vents, and a frog that turns almost invisible. Now, two questions for you. First: if you could explore the deep sea in a robot, what would you look for first? Second: if you could turn invisible for one day, where would you hide? Talk about it with your family!
blocks.title: 结束语与互动问题
blocks.cn: 我们来想想今天的故事。我们在深海热泉下面发现了一个隐藏的世界，还认识了一只睡觉时会变得几乎看不见的青蛙。现在，轮到回答两个问题。第一：如果你能坐着机器人去探索深海，你最先想找什么？第二：如果你能隐身一整天，你会藏到哪里去？和家人聊聊吧！

blocks.en: That's all for today, young explorers. Like the deep-sea scientists, read between the lines — and keep exploring. See you tomorrow morning!
blocks.title: 告别
blocks.cn: 今天的节目就到这里啦，小小探险家们。像深海科学家一样，读懂字里行间——继续探索吧。明天早上见！

quiz.title: B. 单项选择（Single Choice）
questions:
Where did SuBastian find the hidden caves?
A. On a beach
B. Under volcanic rock at a deep-sea vent
C. Inside a ship
D. On a rainforest leaf

What do glassfrogs hide in their liver while they sleep?
A. Food
B. Water
C. Almost ninety percent of their red blood cells
D. Tiny stones

What does "read between the lines" mean?
A. Read very fast
B. Notice clues and understand what is not said
C. Read only the first line
D. Write a letter

Why is the glassfrog hard to see when it sleeps?
A. It changes colour to blue
B. Its body becomes much more see-through
C. It hides under the ground
D. It closes its eyes

children.text: , light passes through the frog's body,
With the red cells out of the way
：with + 名词（the red cells）+ 介词短语（out of the way，挪开的），整个短语表示一种伴随状态——“在红细胞已经挪开的情况下”。读到 with 开头，要立刻把它当成背景条件，而不是主句。
light passes through the frog's body
前面的逗号不要丢——两个完整句子并列时，and 前面要加逗号。
two or three times more see-through
：two or three times（两三倍）+ more + 形容词（see-through，透明的）=“比原来透明两三倍”。倍数表达的公式就是：数字 + times + more + 形容词。
背景条件（红细胞挪开）→ 光能穿过身体（结果一）→ 并且变得更透明（结果二，倍数说清程度）
。一句话里藏着条件、并列和倍数三个机关。
"lifted heavy pieces of volcanic rock — and underneath … it found warm, hidden caves."
"it packs almost ninety percent of its red blood cells into its liver."
"If you read between the lines, you notice clues and understand what is not said."
. With the red cells out of the way,
"it becomes two or three times more see-through."
D. Your own translations — there is no key for this part. Read your Chinese aloud and check that it sounds natural.
🌟 全部答对就是今日 MVP！
